meta.name: severity_scoring
meta.title: Bug severity scoring
meta.description: Dev set for harness tuning: new items in the same style as the golden severity_scoring set.

severity.instructions: How severe is the problem described in `report`, judged by its impact on users rather than the reporter's tone?
criteria: cosmetic: a visual or wording issue with no effect on what users can do
minor: a feature misbehaves but users have an easy workaround
major: a core feature is broken for some or all users with no reasonable workaround
critical: data loss or corruption, a security or privacy breach, or the whole product unavailable

tags.easy: Straightforward: tone, topic and impact all point to the same level
tags.hard: Needs care: tone, topic words or a stated workaround point away from the correct level
tags.loud_but_minor: Reporter is angry or shouting but the impact is only cosmetic or minor
tags.calm_but_critical: Polite or understated report of data loss, a security/privacy breach or a full outage
tags.workaround_stated: The report mentions a workaround (easy or not)
tags.security: Topic: authentication, access control, credentials or privacy
tags.data_loss: Topic: data deleted, lost or corrupted
tags.outage: Topic: the product or a platform is unavailable or won't load
tags.ui_text: Topic: wording, labels, typos or copy
tags.boundary: Sits near a level boundary; the rationale explains which rubric rule decides it

input.report: The welcome tooltip on Quillpad's first-run screen says 'Click hear to create your first notebook'. Should be 'here'.

rationale: A spelling mistake in tooltip copy changes nothing users can do: cosmetic.

input.report: In Ferncast's dark theme, podcast cover art in the episode list has a thin white border around it. Light theme looks fine and episodes play normally.

rationale: A stray border on artwork is a visual issue with no functional effect.

input.report: ABSOLUTELY RIDICULOUS. Every time I place a Brewlist order the app throws CONFETTI at me like I'm five years old. My order goes through, the pickup time is right, the receipt is right, but I am a GROWN ADULT and I want this childish nonsense GONE. Escalate this to whoever is in charge!!!

rationale: The reporter is furious, but they confirm ordering works correctly; a disliked animation is purely visual, so cosmetic.

input.report: The sync icon in the Quillpad desktop sidebar keeps spinning forever, even after sync has finished. The 'Last synced' time updates correctly and every note shows up on my other devices straight away.

rationale: It looks like sync misbehaves, but sync itself works and users can do everything as before; only the indicator animation is wrong, so cosmetic rather than minor.

input.report: In Harborly's delivery analytics, the 'Delayed' series is drawn in orange in both the chart and its legend, but the brand guide says delayed status should be red. The numbers are correct.

rationale: A colour that differs from the brand guide, with correct data and a matching legend, is cosmetic.

input.report: Ferncast resets the playback speed to 1x whenever you move to the next episode. Picking 1.5x again from the player menu works for that episode.

rationale: The speed setting doesn't persist, but re-selecting it is an easy workaround: minor.

input.report: On the Brewlist tablet layout the 'Reorder' shortcut on the home screen is missing. Opening Order history and tapping 'Order again' on the last order does the same thing.

rationale: A missing shortcut with an equivalent path one screen away is minor.

input.report: Exporting a large Quillpad notebook to PDF now takes about 20 seconds instead of 5. The PDF comes out complete and correct.

rationale: Slower but working export is usable performance degradation, which the rubric treats as minor.

input.report: I am DISGUSTED with the Mendo booking page. Your date field won't let me TYPE a date, I have to click the little arrows month by month like it's 1998. It took me SIX clicks to get to March. Yes, the appointment booked fine, but this is an insult to your patients.

rationale: Despite the outrage, typed date entry misbehaves while the calendar arrows book the appointment successfully, an easy workaround: minor.

input.report: The Harborly driver app's barcode scanner can't read parcel labels that are creased or wet. Drivers can type the 12-digit tracking number into the field under the camera view and the delivery is confirmed as normal.

rationale: Scanning fails for some labels, but typing the tracking number is an easy workaround, so minor.

input.report: No new episodes have appeared for any podcast in Ferncast since Monday. Feeds that published several episodes this week still show last week's as the latest, and there's no manual refresh option.

rationale: Getting new episodes is a core feature broken for all users with no workaround: major.

input.report: Clinicians on Mendo's EU-hosted clinics get 'Signature service error' when signing prescriptions. Unsigned prescriptions can't be sent to the pharmacy and there's no other way to sign them.

rationale: Prescription signing is a core feature broken for some users with no workaround: major.

input.report: Harborly's route optimiser fails with 'Plan could not be generated' for any depot with more than 200 stops a day. Dispatchers can still order stops by hand on the map, but for our bigger depots that takes most of the morning.

rationale: A workaround is mentioned, but hand-planning hundreds of stops is not an easy workaround, so the broken core feature is major, not minor.

input.report: Since 6am every Brewlist store in Canada shows 'Ordering unavailable' in the app and on the web. US and UK stores are taking orders as normal.

rationale: It reads like an outage, but only one region's users are affected while the product works elsewhere; whole-product unavailability is what makes critical, so this is major.

input.report: Collaborators invited to a shared Quillpad notebook get 'Access denied' when they open it, even with edit permission. Owners can still open their own notebooks, but nobody can work on shared ones together.

rationale: An access-control topic, but access is wrongly denied rather than exposed: no breach, so a core collaboration feature broken for some users is major.

input.report: Emptying the trash in Quillpad also permanently deletes every pinned note across all notebooks. They can't be restored from anywhere.

rationale: Irrecoverable deletion of user notes is data loss: critical.

input.report: Mendo's patient search for front-desk staff returns patients from every clinic on the platform, not just their own, including diagnoses, phone numbers and home addresses.

rationale: Exposing other clinics' patient records is a privacy breach: critical.

input.report: no rush on this, but harborly web, the driver app and the api have all been timing out for every account we've checked for about 40 min. pinged two other harborly customers and they're seeing the same.

rationale: Low-key and unhurried, but the whole product is unavailable across customers, a full outage: critical.

input.report: Quick question whenever you have a moment! I re-uploaded the audio for episode 12 of my show on Ferncast to fix a small mistake, and now episodes 1 to 11 all play episode 12's audio. The original files aren't in my media library any more and your support team said they were overwritten. No worries if this takes a while to look at.

rationale: Politely framed, but eleven episodes' audio has been overwritten and support confirmed the originals are gone, which is data loss: critical.

input.report: Merging two duplicate customer profiles in the Brewlist store admin sets the loyalty points balance on the merged profile to zero and erases the points history of both. The old balances can't be recovered.

rationale: Customer records are irrecoverably wiped by a merge, which is data loss: critical.
